verdict.rationale: Pylon is documented as a hosted SaaS customer-support platform, and a self-hosted deployment is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence describes a self-hosted, on-prem or customer-deployed option. The US/EU API server entries are vendor-hosted production regions, not self-hosting, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
